extracted.name: Small Buttermilk Balls air fry
extracted.description: Just some bread to serve with a meal
instruction_lines: Mix all the ingredients together except the topper ingredient. Mix to form a dough. Knead till it makes a smooth ball. Separate into 18 equal pieces. Put on parchment paper in the air fryer racks.
Bake at 400° Fahrenheit. Baste with buttermilk on top. Cook for 6 minutes and rotate the racks. Cook for 4 minutes more.
Let rest 2 minutes and serve I hope you enjoy!!!
